## Why Excel Fails as a Sample Management Solution


Many biotech startups start with simple tracking methods like Excel. However, as sample volumes increase, these methods quickly become inefficient. Some of the most common issues include:


- **Lack of Hierarchical Tracking:** Labs need to link biological samples to projects, customers, and related clinical data management.
- **Data Security Risks:** Storing clinical information in Excel increases the risk of unauthorized access and data loss.
- **Limited Workflow Documentation:** Scientists require[workflow documentation software](https://www.scispot.com/workflow-automation) to track reagents used, data generation, and experiment history.
- **Complex User Access Needs:** Labs need role-based access control for labs to manage permissions effectively.


These challenges highlight the need for an advanced[sample management system](https://www.scispot.com/sample-manager) that is purpose-built for biotech research.
